Hotels.Name: Hotel Mimosa
Hotels.Description:
Hotel Mimosa first opened its doors in 1978 and has been welcoming guests ever since. Drawn by a prime location just opposite the long sandy shores of Sidari beach, visitors to this well-equipped hotel can enjoy sublime sea views.

Designed to be bright, airy and with comfort in mind, Hotel Mimosa's rooms are cheerfully decorated with pops of colour. Out on the terrace facing the sea, there's two pools - one with a children's section - matched with two poolside snack bars. Breakfast and dinner are served in the hotel's spacious buffet restaurant but there's no need to move from your sun lounger if you feel like a snack thanks to a trolley service that brings fresh fruit and ice cream straight to you. Once evening falls, there's plenty to keep all ages entertained with live entertainment that includes karaoke and bingo and table tennis tables.

Hotel Mimosa is right in the heart of Sidari meaning that you're just a hop, skip and a jump away from lively bars and restaurants.
